relevance.note: exclude takes precedence; include AND context required; only engaged rows are checked

dedupe_strategy: cross-keyword by tweet_id: keep highest engagement; tie -> first seen

limits.low_yield: f=top + engagement>=50 + relevance may yield few rows; threshold not lowered.
limits.suggestion: 若第三档不足 10 条：建议扩大 raw（每词 >60 或更多关键词）、阈值下调至 30/20（需用户确认）并扩充同义词/排除词；当前相关计数@50=45、@30=46、@20=48
limits.attempt_note: run1 CLI false RISK_CONTROL (/Challenge/i matched tweet text 'challenges'); collection used tools/collect_search.py with selector-based risk check; original x_collect.py unchanged.
